title: RulePromotionReceipt.v1
description: The receipt that promotes a RuleCandidate to an active DeterministicRule (M6→M7). It is the single warrant the promotion gate emits ONLY when every bar is met, and it REQUIRES the evidence handles: a replay_report_id AND a shadow_report_id (you cannot promote without both), plus a fallback_policy (no active rule without a fallback). The boolean gate fields record what was checked: schema_valid, handles_preserved (source handles survive the rule), precision_met (against the rule_class threshold), unsafe_fp_zero (==0 for a truth_serving rule), tenant_safe (no tenant_private→global leak), traces_preserved (lossless — the distilled-from traces are kept). For a truth_serving FIRST promotion human_review_signed must be true. distilled_from_trace_ids carries the lossless link the promoted rule inherits. Deterministic when promoted_at is injected.

promotion_receipt_id.description: content-addressed id over the candidate + report ids + gate results; deterministic

rule_class.description: sets the bar — truth_serving requires unsafe_fp_zero AND human_review_signed for a first promotion

replay_report_id.description: REQUIRED — the RuleReplayReport proving precision over historical verified traces

shadow_report_id.description: REQUIRED — the ShadowRunReport proving no unsafe live mismatch

fallback_policy.description: REQUIRED — the fallback the promoted rule carries; promotion without a fallback is invalid

schema_valid.description: the rule body + I/O validate against schema

handles_preserved.description: the rule preserves source handles on every decision it serves

precision_met.description: replay precision met the rule_class threshold

unsafe_fp_zero.description: unsafe_false_positives==0 in replay AND unsafe_mismatch_count==0 in shadow; MUST be true for truth_serving

tenant_safe.description: no tenant_private trace was used to make a global decision; tenant_leak_count==0

traces_preserved.description: LOSSLESS — the LLM/consensus/adjudication traces this rule was distilled from are KEPT, not deleted

human_review_signed.description: an accountable human signed off; REQUIRED true for a truth_serving rule's first promotion

distilled_from_trace_ids.description: the lossless link the promoted rule inherits; these traces are never deleted

rollback_target_id.description: the prior path the rule reverts to if rolled back (the LLM/human fallback path); promotion is reversible
